I am writing to express my interest in the Full-Stack Engineer role at Brightline Labs. With six years of backend engineering experience at Northwind Robotics, where I owned a TypeScript on Node.js order-routing service handling approximately 2 million events per day on PostgreSQL, I have developed a strong foundation in the core technologies you use. Additionally, my two years as engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, where I led a team of five across dispatch and billing product lines, have honed my ability to deliver robust solutions in collaborative environments.

My technical experience aligns closely with your stack. I have extensive production experience with TypeScript and Node.js, and I have designed schemas, tuned queries, and implemented logical replication in PostgreSQL. I also led a nine-month strangler-fig migration of a monolith to event-driven services, achieving zero customer-visible downtime and reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340 milliseconds. Furthermore, I have deployed services using Kubernetes and Terraform, which would support the developer tools you build for research teams.

I am particularly drawn to Brightline Labs because of your focus on developer tools for research teams and your use of Next.js and Node. I prefer remote-first teams operating in European time zones, and I am eager to bring my full-stack capabilities and infrastructure experience to your engineering team. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background can contribute to your mission.
